column3: ## Request Revisions on an Update Request

Setup: Use the application_state_change testdrive - it supplies a Ready-status update request titled 'Application State Change - Revisions Required Update Request <run_seed>', already linked to its own in-DOAJ journal. OR provide one yourself.

Setup: Important: the testdrive page tears down its data as soon as you navigate away from it. Log in and run the test in a separate browser tab/window, leaving the testdrive tab open until you have finished.
Go to the "Applications/Update Requests" page in the Administration area
Search for the testdrive's "Revisions Required Update Request" record (it is in status Ready) and click "Review update"
Complete any required fields, and then change the Application Status to "Revisions Required"

column4: A flash message indicates that an email was sent to the owner of the update request
A flash message indicates that the application was updated
